findings.finding: New Questions lacks descriptors; catalogue still reports zero provider calls and old conservative component policy.
findings.resolution: Catalogue reflects open admitted-evidence LLM policy and avoids descriptors dependency.

findings.finding: Feedback uses controller.next and mutable Composer.query/scopes from previous call, risking stale context rather than current selected step and retrieval.
findings.resolution: Feedback clears stale mutable context and composes only the freshly selected sid/current query.

findings.finding: Already-known applicable safety stops depend on successful new retrieval; retrieval failure returns SYSTEM_ERROR before independent safety routing.
findings.resolution: Confirmed non-policy source-backed typed hazard predicates route before retrieval; retrieval tags alone do not establish a known hazard.

findings.finding: Session status unconditionally resets OPEN, including customer-reported resolved state; preserve resolution and pending typed semantics explicitly.
findings.resolution: Answer preserves customer-reported resolved status and advances version without rewriting typed history.

findings.finding: Prompt-cache creation reserves zero tokens; paid prefix storage/context must have explicit bounded spend allowance or disabled unsupported capability.
findings.resolution: Supported explicit prompt cache reserves provider-counted stable-prefix tokens; creation count, lifetime and retained entries are bounded; unsupported exact-model capability remains explicit.

findings.finding: Eligible exact-response hits skip complete admitted-context byte/token budget checks owned by provider.complete.
findings.resolution: Exact reviewed response hits pass whole-context byte and provider token counting with no mandatory-evidence truncation.

findings.finding: No reviewed exact-cache loader is configured; eligible response caching is an empty hook.
findings.resolution: Reviewed responses derive exact bound planner questions and canonical approved claims, fresh admitted scope and empty active state; arbitrary supplied cache dictionaries are prohibited.

findings.finding: Known-safety new-question return initially kept old version and would fail durable commit.
findings.resolution: Version advances before known-safety routing; regression checks 7 to 8 with retrieval unavailable.

findings.finding: Clarification owners use canonical records rather than runtime step IDs.
findings.resolution: Compare current step canonical_record_id to bound owners, retain step/source/rule hash checks.

findings.finding: EXP003 legacy fallback could issue Boolean capabilities for mismatched displayed question.
findings.resolution: Reviewed ambiguity requires exact question text; mismatch or absent reviewed binding yields no Boolean choices.

findings.finding: Python equality could normalize numeric thought=1 as empty True marker.
findings.resolution: Exact dictionary keys plus thought is True; all remaining thought flags require Boolean type, nonempty thoughts and paid thought tokens are rejected.

findings.finding: Initial table projection failed on two approved tables with unmatched grid cells.
findings.resolution: Retain all nonredundant grid cells and row lengths; reversible columnar encoding preserves every non-bbox field, missing/null/false distinction and value. Independent whole-corpus round-trip tests pass.

findings.finding: Inherited legacy envelope applied exact-answer text/variant format restrictions to unused authored FACT/ACTION text, blocking evidence-admitted generation.
findings.resolution: Replace envelope call with explicit source/step authority, TRUE eligibility, figure hold, reviewed roles/action count, immutable claim IDs/evidence membership, approved policy caveats and complete mandatory coverage. Apply exact display format only to server-appended warnings/prerequisites/caveats. Version admission contract SOURCE_AND_MANDATORY_DISPLAY_ONLY_V2.

limitations: Approval is exact-byte scoped software review; any serving/prompt/cache/source-binding change needs a new review and manifest.

Deterministic citation membership, roles and step/schema checks are not semantic entailment proof; generated FACT text may still misstate evidence or disguise a procedure. Original-PDF claim evaluation remains mandatory.
No separate final semantic-verifier provider call is introduced.
Question wording is not an admission allowlist. Coverage remains limited to approved evidence scopes and retained retrieval candidates; it is not whole-manual answerability.
Bounded ranking may omit a useful lower-ranked factual scope or safety scope for an initial raw question; model interpretation of raw hazards and relevance requires held-out evaluation.
Provider prompt-cache code is capability gated; mocked explicit-cache tests do not prove exact selected-model support or real savings.
The 28 clarification polarity bindings have separate source review authority; this review validates capability integrity and typed mapping, not their original-page semantic correctness.

Hosted runtime/full regression receipts, freshly authored held-out generated-claim/original-page review, deployed privacy/ownership/durable-streaming acceptance and budget receipts are outside this approval and still govern public release.

Projection round-trip preservation does not establish correct original PDF extraction, OCR, table interpretation, warning scope or generated claim support. Coordinate metadata remains server-owned in original objects; compact provider encoding may affect model interpretation and must be evaluated on fresh held-out claims.

Active provider account token-per-minute quota and transient HTTP429 availability are not established by the project reservation caps. At most one explicitly rejected retry remains bounded and uncertainty fails closed as SYSTEM_ERROR; measured served coverage must report provider failures separately.

Live v3 hosted run and its original-page generated-claim adjudication are not evidence in this software-only approval. Neither prior successful generated routes nor authored regression answers prove new runtime release acceptance.

Fuse refusal recognizer uses conservative English lexical patterns, not semantic equivalence or a comprehensive hazard classifier; false positives, omissions and mixed-intent questions require held-out evaluation. A pattern match only refuses and cannot authorize a positive technical step.

The10000 reserved token-minute cap is a configured protective ceiling, not proof of the provider account actual TPM quota or freedom from429 failures. Explicitly rejected retries consume additional reservations and may be denied by the cap.

Fresh source-context label holds reduce supported coverage. Omitted or HELD contexts abstain rather than become rider questions; approval of labels is not proof generated claims remain within the governing procedure.
No new hosted full-regression, original-PDF generated-claim result, public access test, spend receipt or live deployment is credited by this exact software review.
